column2:
hairdresser(n.)美髮師
hairdressing(n.)美髮業
go to the hairdresser 去美髮院
skilled hairdresser 技術好的美髮師
I go to the hairdresser to get my hair cut every month.
(我每個月都去美髮院剪頭髮。)
The hairdresser suggested a shorter style for summer.
(美髮師建議我夏天剪短一點的髮型。)

hallway(n.)走廊、玄關
hall(n.)大廳、會堂
long hallway 長廊
in the hallway 在走廊上
Students are not allowed to run in the hallway.
(學生不准在走廊上奔跑。)
She left her wet shoes in the hallway.
(她把濕鞋子留在玄關。)

hammer(n./v.)鐵鎚、用鎚子敲打
(無詞性變化)
hammer a nail 釘釘子
hammer home 反覆強調
He used a hammer to fix the broken chair.
(他用鐵鎚修理壞掉的椅子。)
Dad hammered a nail into the wall to hang the picture.
(爸爸在牆上釘了一根釘子來掛畫。)

handful(n.)一把、少數、難管的人
(無詞性變化)
a handful of 一把、少數的
quite a handful 很難管教
Only a handful of students came to the meeting.
(只有少數幾個學生來參加會議。)
She gave the birds a handful of rice.
(她給那些鳥一把米。)

handkerchief(n.)手帕
(無詞性變化)
cotton handkerchief 棉質手帕
wipe with a handkerchief 用手帕擦
He wiped his face with a handkerchief.
(他用手帕擦了擦臉。)
My grandfather always carries a handkerchief in his pocket.
(我爺爺口袋裡總是帶著一條手帕。)

handy(adj.)方便的、手巧的、手邊的
handily(adv.)輕易地
come in handy 派上用場
keep... handy 把……放在手邊
A small flashlight will come in handy during a blackout.
(停電時一支小手電筒就會派上用場。)
My uncle is very handy and can fix almost anything.
(我叔叔手很巧，幾乎什麼都會修。)

hanger(n.)衣架、掛鉤
hang(v.)掛、懸掛
coat hanger 衣架
hang on a hanger 掛在衣架上
Please put your coat on a hanger.
(請把你的外套掛在衣架上。)
We need more hangers for all these new clothes.
(我們需要更多衣架來掛這些新衣服。)

harbor(n./v.)港口、避難所、懷有(想法)、窩藏
(無詞性變化)
fishing harbor 漁港
harbor a grudge 懷恨在心
Many fishing boats are resting in the harbor.
(許多漁船停泊在港口裡。)
She still harbors hope that her lost dog will return.
(她仍懷抱著走失的狗會回來的希望。)

harm(n./v.)傷害、損害
harmful(adj.)有害的
harmless(adj.)無害的
do harm to 對……有害
no harm done 沒造成傷害、沒關係
Too much sugar can do harm to your teeth.
(太多糖會傷害你的牙齒。)
The storm did not harm anyone in the village.
(這場暴風雨沒有傷到村裡任何人。)

harmful(adj.)有害的
harm(n./v.)傷害
harmless(adj.)無害的
harmful effects 有害影響
harmful to health 對健康有害
Smoking is harmful to your health.
(抽菸對你的健康有害。)
Some chemicals are harmful to plants and animals.
(有些化學物質對動植物有害。)

harvest(n./v.)收成、收穫、收割
(無詞性變化)
rice harvest 稻米收成
harvest season 收穫季節
Farmers are busy during the harvest season.
(農夫們在收穫季節很忙碌。)
We harvested a lot of tomatoes from our garden this year.
(今年我們從菜園收成了許多番茄。)

hasty(adj.)匆忙的、草率的
haste(n.)急忙、倉促
hastily(adv.)匆忙地
hasty decision 草率的決定
hasty meal 匆忙的一餐
Don't make a hasty decision when you are angry.
(生氣時不要做草率的決定。)
He ate a hasty breakfast and ran to the bus stop.
(他匆匆吃完早餐就跑向公車站。)

hatch(n./v.)孵化、策劃、艙口
(無詞性變化)
hatch a plan 策劃計畫
hatch from an egg 從蛋中孵出
The baby chicks hatched from their eggs this morning.
(小雞今天早上從蛋裡孵出來了。)
The kids hatched a plan to surprise their mother.
(孩子們策劃了一個要給媽媽驚喜的計畫。)

hateful(adj.)可恨的、充滿仇恨的
hate(v./n.)討厭、仇恨
hatred(n.)憎恨
hateful words 充滿惡意的話
hateful attitude 惡劣的態度
Posting hateful comments online can hurt people deeply.
(在網路上發表充滿惡意的留言會深深傷害他人。)
I don't like his hateful attitude toward others.
(我不喜歡他對別人那種惡劣的態度。)

hay(n.)乾草
(無詞性變化)
make hay while the sun shines 把握時機
bale of hay 一捆乾草
The farmer fed the horses some fresh hay.
(農夫餵馬吃了一些新鮮的乾草。)
The barn was filled with bales of hay.
(穀倉裡堆滿了一捆捆乾草。)

headline(n./v.)標題、頭條、擔任主角
(無詞性變化)
front-page headline 頭版頭條
make headlines 成為頭條新聞
The news about the earthquake made headlines around the world.
(那則地震新聞登上了全球的頭條。)
I only had time to read the headlines this morning.
(今天早上我只有時間看新聞標題。)

headquarters(n.)總部、總公司
(無詞性變化)
company headquarters 公司總部
police headquarters 警察總局
The company's headquarters is located in Taipei.
(這家公司的總部位於臺北。)
He was sent to work at the headquarters for a year.
(他被派到總部工作一年。)

heal(v.)治癒、癒合
healer(n.)治療者
healing(n.)治療、癒合
heal a wound 使傷口癒合
time heals 時間會撫平一切
It took two weeks for the cut on my finger to heal.
(我手指上的傷口花了兩週才癒合。)
They say time heals all wounds.
(人們說時間會撫平所有的傷痛。)

heap(n./v.)一堆、堆積、大量
(無詞性變化)
a heap of 一堆
heap up 堆起來
There is a heap of dirty clothes on his bed.
(他床上有一堆髒衣服。)
She heaped food onto my plate.
(她在我的盤子上堆滿了食物。)

heater(n.)暖氣機、加熱器
heat(n./v.)熱、加熱
water heater 熱水器
turn on the heater 打開暖氣
We turned on the heater because it was freezing.
(因為天氣很冷，我們打開了暖氣。)
The water heater in our house is broken.
(我們家的熱水器壞了。)

heel(n./v.)腳跟、鞋跟、緊跟
(無詞性變化)
high heels 高跟鞋
on the heels of 緊接在……之後
She wore high heels to the party.
(她穿高跟鞋去參加派對。)
My new shoes rubbed against my heel and hurt.
(我的新鞋磨到腳跟，很痛。)

hell(n.)地獄、苦境
hellish(adj.)地獄般的、可怕的
go through hell 歷經磨難
a living hell 人間地獄
Being stuck in traffic for four hours was hell.
(塞車塞了四個小時簡直是地獄。)
He went through hell before he finally recovered.
(他歷經了許多磨難才終於康復。)

helmet(n.)安全帽、頭盔
(無詞性變化)
wear a helmet 戴安全帽
bike helmet 自行車頭盔
You must wear a helmet when riding a scooter.
(騎機車時你必須戴安全帽。)
The helmet saved his life in the accident.
(那頂安全帽在意外中救了他一命。)

hesitate(v.)猶豫、遲疑
hesitation(n.)猶豫
hesitant(adj.)猶豫的
don't hesitate to 別猶豫、儘管
without hesitation 毫不猶豫
Don't hesitate to ask me if you have any questions.
(如果你有任何問題，儘管問我。)
She hesitated for a moment before answering.
(她猶豫了一下才回答。)

hint(n./v.)暗示、提示、線索
(無詞性變化)
give a hint 給提示
drop a hint 暗示
Can you give me a hint about the answer?
(你可以給我一點答案的提示嗎？)
She hinted that she wanted a new phone for her birthday.
(她暗示自己生日想要一支新手機。)

hire(v./n.)僱用、租用、受僱者
(無詞性變化)
hire a car 租車
new hire 新進員工
The restaurant plans to hire two more waiters.
(那家餐廳打算再僱用兩名服務生。)
We hired a boat to visit the small island.
(我們租了一艘船去那座小島。)

historian(n.)歷史學家
history(n.)歷史
historical(adj.)歷史的、史學的
art historian 藝術史學家
famous historian 知名歷史學家
The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
(那位歷史學家寫了一本關於古羅馬的書。)
Historians still argue about the cause of the war.
(歷史學家們仍在爭論那場戰爭的起因。)

historic(adj.)有歷史意義的、歷史上著名的
history(n.)歷史
historical(adj.)歷史的、史學的
historic building 古蹟建築
historic moment 歷史性的時刻
Tainan has many historic temples and buildings.
(臺南有許多具歷史意義的廟宇和建築。)
Landing on the moon was a historic moment.
(登陸月球是一個歷史性的時刻。)

holder(n.)持有者、支架、容器
hold(v./n.)握住、舉行
record holder 紀錄保持人
cup holder 杯架
She is the national record holder in the 100-meter race.
(她是百公尺賽跑的全國紀錄保持人。)
He put his pen back into the pen holder.
(他把筆放回筆筒裡。)

hollow(adj./n./v.)中空的、空洞的、凹處、挖空
(無詞性變化)
hollow tree 空心樹
hollow promise 空洞的承諾
The squirrel hid its nuts in a hollow tree.
(松鼠把堅果藏在一棵空心的樹裡。)
His words sounded hollow to everyone.
(他的話對大家來說聽起來很空洞。)

holy(adj.)神聖的
holiness(n.)神聖
holy place 聖地
Holy Bible 聖經
Visitors should be quiet in this holy place.
(遊客在這個神聖的地方應保持安靜。)
Jerusalem is a holy city for several religions.
(耶路撒冷是好幾個宗教的聖城。)

homesick(adj.)想家的、思鄉的
homesickness(n.)思鄉病
feel homesick 想家
get homesick 開始想家
I felt homesick during my first week at summer camp.
(夏令營的第一週我很想家。)
Many exchange students get homesick at the beginning.
(許多交換學生一開始都會想家。)

hometown(n.)家鄉、故鄉
(無詞性變化)
return to one's hometown 回鄉
hometown hero 家鄉英雄
He returned to his hometown after graduating from college.
(他大學畢業後回到了家鄉。)
My hometown is famous for its beautiful beaches.
(我的家鄉以美麗的海灘聞名。)

honesty(n.)誠實、正直
honest(adj.)誠實的
honestly(adv.)老實說、誠實地
in all honesty 老實說
Honesty is the best policy. 誠實為上策
Honesty is the most important quality in a friend.
(誠實是朋友最重要的特質。)
The teacher praised the boy for his honesty.
(老師稱讚那個男孩很誠實。)

honor(n./v.)榮譽、尊敬、使增光
honorable(adj.)光榮的、正直的
in honor of 為紀念、向……致敬
an honor 一項殊榮
It is a great honor to meet you.
(能見到您是我莫大的榮幸。)
A party was held in honor of the retiring teacher.
(為了向即將退休的老師致敬，舉辦了一場派對。)

hopeful(adj.)抱有希望的、有希望的
hope(n./v.)希望
hopefully(adv.)但願、有希望地
feel hopeful 感到充滿希望
hopeful sign 好兆頭
We are hopeful that the weather will improve tomorrow.
(我們希望明天天氣會好轉。)
The doctor gave us some hopeful news.
(醫生給了我們一些令人振奮的消息。)

horn(n.)角、喇叭、號角
(無詞性變化)
honk the horn 按喇叭
French horn 法國號
The driver honked the horn at the slow car.
(那位駕駛對著開得很慢的車按喇叭。)
A rhino has one or two horns on its nose.
(犀牛的鼻子上有一或兩隻角。)

horrible(adj.)可怕的、糟透的
horror(n.)恐怖
horribly(adv.)可怕地、非常
horrible accident 可怕的意外
horrible smell 難聞的氣味
There was a horrible smell coming from the trash can.
(垃圾桶傳來一股難聞的氣味。)
We had horrible weather during our trip.
(我們旅行時天氣糟透了。)

horror(n.)恐怖、震驚
horrible(adj.)可怕的
horrify(v.)使驚嚇
horror movie 恐怖片
in horror 驚恐地
I can't sleep after watching a horror movie.
(看完恐怖片後我就睡不著。)
She screamed in horror when she saw the snake.
(她看到那條蛇時驚恐地尖叫。)

hourly(adj./adv.)每小時的、每小時一次
hour(n.)小時
hourly wage 時薪
hourly update 每小時更新
The buses to the airport run hourly.
(往機場的公車每小時一班。)
Her hourly wage at the coffee shop is quite low.
(她在咖啡店的時薪相當低。)

housekeeper(n.)管家、女管家
housekeeping(n.)家務管理、房務
hire a housekeeper 請管家
hotel housekeeper 飯店房務人員
The housekeeper cleans the house twice a week.
(管家一週打掃房子兩次。)
They hired a housekeeper to help take care of the kids.
(他們請了一位管家幫忙照顧孩子。)

hug(n./v.)擁抱
(無詞性變化)
give someone a hug 擁抱某人
big hug 大大的擁抱
She gave her mother a big hug at the airport.
(她在機場給了媽媽一個大大的擁抱。)
The two friends hugged each other after the game.
(比賽結束後，兩個朋友互相擁抱。)

hum(v.)哼歌、發出嗡嗡聲
(無詞性變化)
hum a song 哼歌
hum along 跟著哼
She always hums a song while she cooks.
(她做菜時總是哼著歌。)
The old refrigerator hums all night long.
(那台舊冰箱整晚都發出嗡嗡聲。)

humid(adj.)潮濕的
humidity(n.)濕度
hot and humid 濕熱的
humid climate 潮濕的氣候
Summer in Taiwan is usually hot and humid.
(臺灣的夏天通常又熱又潮濕。)
Bread goes bad quickly in humid weather.
(潮濕的天氣裡麵包很快就會壞掉。)

humor(n.)幽默、幽默感、心情
humorous(adj.)幽默的
sense of humor 幽默感
in good humor 心情好
My English teacher has a great sense of humor.
(我的英文老師很有幽默感。)
His speech was full of humor and everyone laughed.
(他的演講充滿幽默，大家都笑了。)

humorous(adj.)幽默的、滑稽的
humor(n.)幽默
humorously(adv.)幽默地
humorous story 幽默的故事
humorous remark 風趣的話
He told a humorous story about his first day at school.
(他講了一個關於自己上學第一天的有趣故事。)
The book is both humorous and touching.
(這本書既幽默又感人。)

hunger(n.)飢餓、渴望
hungry(adj.)飢餓的
hungrily(adv.)飢餓地
die of hunger 餓死
hunger for knowledge 渴望知識
Millions of people around the world still suffer from hunger.
(全世界仍有數百萬人飽受飢餓之苦。)
She has a strong hunger for knowledge.
(她非常渴望求知。)

hut(n.)小屋、茅舍
(無詞性變化)
wooden hut 木屋
mountain hut 山屋
The hikers spent the night in a mountain hut.
(登山客在山屋裡過夜。)
The old fisherman lives in a small wooden hut.
(那位老漁夫住在一間小木屋裡。)

icy(adj.)結冰的、冰冷的、冷淡的
ice(n.)冰
icy road 結冰的路面
icy stare 冷淡的目光
Drive slowly because the roads are icy.
(開慢一點，因為路面結冰了。)
An icy wind blew through the valley.
(一陣冰冷的風吹過山谷。)

imagination(n.)想像力、想像
imagine(v.)想像
imaginative(adj.)富有想像力的
use your imagination 發揮想像力
beyond imagination 超乎想像
Children often have a rich imagination.
(孩子們通常有豐富的想像力。)
Use your imagination to finish the story.
(發揮你的想像力把故事寫完。)

immediate(adj.)立即的、直接的、最接近的
immediately(adv.)立刻
immediate action 立即行動
immediate family 直系親屬
The problem needs immediate action.
(這個問題需要立即採取行動。)
Only immediate family members were invited to the wedding.
(只有直系親屬受邀參加婚禮。)

import(n./v.)進口、進口貨
importer(n.)進口商
import goods 進口商品
import tax 進口稅
Taiwan imports a lot of oil from other countries.
(臺灣從其他國家進口大量石油。)
The price of imports has risen this year.
(今年進口商品的價格上漲了。)

impress(v.)使印象深刻、使欽佩
impression(n.)印象
impressive(adj.)令人印象深刻的
be impressed by 對……印象深刻
impress on 使銘記
I was impressed by her excellent English.
(她出色的英文讓我印象深刻。)
He tried hard to impress his new boss.
(他努力想讓新老闆留下好印象。)

indoor(adj.)室內的
indoors(adv.)在室內
indoor activity 室內活動
indoor pool 室內游泳池
Our school has a large indoor swimming pool.
(我們學校有一座大型室內游泳池。)
Reading is a good indoor activity on rainy days.
(閱讀是雨天很好的室內活動。)

indoors(adv.)在室內、進屋內
indoor(adj.)室內的
stay indoors 待在室內
go indoors 進到屋內
We stayed indoors because of the typhoon.
(因為颱風，我們待在室內。)
It started to rain, so the children went indoors.
(開始下雨了，所以孩子們進到屋內。)

industrial(adj.)工業的、產業的
industry(n.)工業、產業
industrialize(v.)使工業化
industrial area 工業區
Industrial Revolution 工業革命
The Industrial Revolution changed the way people lived.
(工業革命改變了人們的生活方式。)
There are many factories in the industrial area.
(工業區裡有許多工廠。)

inferior(adj./n.)較差的、低等的、部屬
inferiority(n.)劣等、自卑
inferior to 比……差
inferior quality 品質低劣
This cheap bag is inferior to the original one.
(這個便宜的包包品質比正品差。)
Never let anyone make you feel inferior.
(絕對不要讓任何人使你感到自卑。)

inform(v.)通知、告知
information(n.)資訊、消息
informative(adj.)提供資訊的、有益的
inform someone of 通知某人某事
keep someone informed 讓某人隨時了解狀況
Please inform us of any changes to your address.
(若您的地址有任何變更，請通知我們。)
The teacher informed the students that the test was canceled.
(老師告知學生考試取消了。)

information(n.)資訊、消息、資料
inform(v.)通知
informative(adj.)提供資訊的
a piece of information 一則資訊
information desk 服務臺、詢問處
You can find more information on our website.
(您可以在我們的網站上找到更多資訊。)
Please ask at the information desk.
(請到服務臺詢問。)

injury(n.)傷害、受傷
injure(v.)使受傷
injured(adj.)受傷的
serious injury 重傷
suffer an injury 受傷
He missed the game because of a knee injury.
(他因為膝傷錯過了比賽。)
Luckily, nobody suffered serious injuries in the accident.
(幸運的是，沒有人在意外中受重傷。)

inn(n.)小旅館、客棧
innkeeper(n.)旅館老闆
country inn 鄉間旅館
stay at an inn 住在小旅館
We stayed at a small inn near the lake.
(我們住在湖邊的一間小旅館。)
